results.name: reader finishes before the blocked client-first writer; fresh reader denies revocation

readerEvents.text:
SELECT m.user_id::text AS "userId", c.memory_wall AS "memoryWall"
    FROM tenants t
    JOIN tenant_memberships m ON m.tenant_id=t.id
    JOIN users u ON u.id=m.user_id
    JOIN clients c ON c.tenant_id=t.id
    WHERE t.id=$1::uuid AND t.status::text='active'
      AND m.user_id=COALESCE($2::uuid,u.id) AND m.status::text='active'
      AND m.role::text IN ('standard_user','user_admin','capiro_admin')
      AND u.clerk_user_id=$3
      AND c.id=$4::uuid AND c.status::text<>'archived'
    FOR SHARE OF t,m,u,c

SELECT id FROM client_memory_access
      WHERE tenant_id=$1::uuid AND client_id=$2::uuid
        AND user_id=$3::uuid FOR SHARE

SELECT version FROM client_objectives
    WHERE tenant_id=$1::uuid AND client_id=$2::uuid
      AND id=$3::uuid AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR SHARE

SELECT id FROM client_objective_revisions
    WHERE tenant_id=$1::uuid AND client_id=$2::uuid
      AND objective_id=$3::uuid AND version=$4
